The main takeaway from our work is that
stative passives do not have argument introducing syntax, and are thus not a Voice construction, but a complex stative construction.

stative passives are a new argument for the claim that stative and eventives have a different syntax: the syntax of stative participles is not argument-structure building, including Voice, as is the syntax of eventive participles (and other eventive verb phrases) The syntax of stative passives supports the traditional view that stative and non-stative verbs have different syntax, including a difference in the syntax of Voice.
